title: MPU6050 Estimating Attitude from the Gravity Vector

attitude.computed: on-target, by the firmware, and recorded as the attitude_deg channels

captures.purpose: full rotation about X, showing the roll wrap at ±180°
rotation about Y, showing pitch limited to ±90° and roll taking over
stationary attitude noise at maximum sensor bandwidth
stationary attitude noise with the sensor bandwidth narrowed
horizontal movement without rotation, showing gravity and linear acceleration being confused

notes: The sensor samples at 1 kHz. Samples reach the host over SWD at roughly 420/s, which is the polling rate of the acquisition and not a property of the sensor.
